title: Project Skeleton Governance
summary: Make NextFrame's repository maintainable after the product loop is proven: clean root, spec in main repo, artifact archive, current docs, and a structure gate.

items.title: Root directory is one-screen understandable
items.verify: find . -maxdepth 2 -type d excludes tmp, episodes, reference noise

items.title: Spec is owned by the main repository
items.verify: spec/.git is absent and git tracks spec/devlog, bdd, versions, standards

items.title: Generated artifacts and history references are outside the repo
items.verify: ../NextFrame.archive contains migrated tmp, episodes, reference, and spec history bundle

items.title: Future structure drift is machine-checked
items.verify: ./scripts/check-structure.sh passes and audit gate calls it

items.title: README and CLAUDE explain current product skeleton
items.verify: README.md and CLAUDE.md describe current v2 JSON editor/export loop and directory map

out_of_scope: Moving Rust crates into new package names
Long export or high-parallel performance benchmarking

ai_tools.command: cargo check -p nf-cli -p nf-shell -p nf-project -p nf-recorder
cd frontend/nf-components && npm run check && npm run build
